blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics (MLS® Home Price Index and sales summaries) and the monthly SnapStats figures. No live feed filtered to this home type and no sold-price data yet.

Cloverdale acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for a detached house in Cloverdale was $1,317,200 in September 2026. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.

blocks.source: Source: Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 5, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Cloverdale: the detached houses benchmark was $1,317,200 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 6.9%; over three months it fell 2.7%; over the last month it fell 1.7%. Longer term, over 3 years it fell 11.3%; over 5 years it fell 5.1%.

Median is the middle sale price of the month and average is the total of sale prices divided by sales; both swing when few homes sell, so a month with fewer than 3 sales is not read as a trend.

blocks.text: In September 2026 Cloverdale had 32 detached houses sales and 201 active listings (33 sales and 201 active in August; 35 and 218 in September 2025). Sales fell 8.6% against September 2025. Active listings fell 7.8% against September 2025.
Detached houses against other home types in Cloverdale

Cloverdale: the detached houses benchmark of $1,317,200 sits $562,900 above the townhomes benchmark of $754,300 (175% of it) and $810,500 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $506,700 (260% of it).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Before you buy acreages in Cloverdale
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: Is Cloverdale a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Cloverdale had a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Cloverdale that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Cloverdale homes?
faq.a: The Cloverdale homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Cloverdale market stats page has the monthly figures.
